_comment: What a game's link is, and which app it is offered to (GameLinks, GameLinkOffer; docs/SPEC.md, 'Links a game opens'). A link matches a kind by scheme, or by domain (the domain itself or any subdomain) and, when given, a path prefix. packages are the apps that handle it, in order of preference; only an installed one that Android says opens the link is offered. A scheme listed here is allowed beside https, http and mailto; nothing else is.
